```{r Config, include=FALSE}
options(
  knitr.kable.NA = "",
  digits = 4
)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  comment = "",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 500
)
```

# 数据分析

```{r}
summary(airquality)
model = lm(Ozone ~ ., data=airquality)
summary(model)
knitr::kable(summary(model)$coefficients, digits=2)  # print regression coefficients table
```
